name: Seminsky Pass
full: Seminsky Pass on the Chuysky Trakt (R256 highway, km 583), Seminsky Range, the watershed of the Sema and Ursul rivers
near: Topuchaya village (western ascent), Tuekta village (eastern descent), the district centers Shebalino and Ongudai
elev: 1717 m (most sources; 1700, 1719 and 1780 m also appear)
short: The highest pass on the Chuysky Trakt (1717 m): cedar taiga, an obelisk marking 200 years since Altai joined Russia, a souvenir market, cafes and a ski base.
desc: Seminsky Pass is the highest point of the Chuysky Trakt (km 583), the boundary between Northern and Central Altai and the watershed of the Sema and Ursul. Its elevation is 1717 m; the ascent from the west is ≈8 km (gaining ≈510 m), and the descent to the east is ≈11 km. The Altai name is Dyal-Menku (“Eternal Mane”); the Russian one is linked either to the Mongolian “sebi” (“fortress”) or to the Sema river. In the 19th century the pass was the hardest section of the road — mud in summer, snowdrifts in winter; it became easily passable only by the 1930s. In 1956 an obelisk was erected here in honor of the 200th anniversary of the voluntary entry of Gorny Altai into Russia (1756). Around it are cedar groves, subalpine meadows with globeflowers (zharki), dwarf-birch scrub; it is a natural monument with four endemics from the Red Data Book of the Altai Republic. Above the pass rise Mount Sarlyk (2507 m), the highest point of the Seminsky Range, and the more accessible Tyukhtya (1899 m). At the roadside area there is a souvenir market (honey, pine nuts, felt, herbs), several cafes and toilets; nearby are the Seminsky Pass training center (since 1986, ski runs up to 1000 m with a drop of up to 200 m) and the Dinamo tourist base. The weather is changeable: snow can fall even in summer, and already in mid-September (12.09.2024).
guide: This is the highest point of the whole trakt — get out of the car and feel how much colder it is here than in Gorno-Altaysk. The obelisk was erected in 1956 for the 200th anniversary of Altai joining Russia — take a photo with the cedars behind it. At the market buy honey, pine nuts and herbal blends, but compare prices — reviews complain about markups. If you have a whole day and good weather, climb Sarlyk (2507 m): “wild yak” in Altai, and from there you can see the Tuyuk Lakes. The ribbons on the trees are dyalama, offerings to the spirits of the pass.
see: The obelisk marking 200 years of Altai joining Russia (1956); a viewing platform with a view of snowy peaks; cedar forest; a souvenir market; Mount Sarlyk (2507 m) and Tyukhtya (1899 m); the Tuyuk Lakes (from Sarlyk); in winter — the ski runs of the training center.
skip: You have already seen plenty of passes and are driving into fog — but the stop is still convenient for stretching your legs, eating and getting a coffee. If you don't like souvenir markets, just stand by the obelisk for 10 minutes.
diff: Easy (the roadside area); Sarlyk — moderate, 8–10 h
when: June–September for views and walks (globeflowers bloom in June); November to May — snow, skiing and snowmobiles; snow is possible in summer too
hours: Around the clock, free; the cafes and market operate in daytime, year-round (per travelto), exact hours not found
daytime: Morning — fewer tour buses and soft light; in the daytime in summer it is very crowded (editorial)
how: Along the Chuysky Trakt R256: ≈150 km from Gorno-Altaysk (≈3 h), ≈140 km from Gorno-Altaysk airport, ≈370 km from Barnaul. All services to Ongudai, Kosh-Agach, Ulagan and back to Biysk/Barnaul go through the pass — Yandex.Schedules has a “Seminsky Pass” stop.
needcar: Yes — a car, a scheduled bus/marshrutka (minibus) or an excursion
roadtype: Paved R256; the ascent is ≈8 km and the descent ≈11 km, with a gentle profile; to Sarlyk — a dirt road past an abandoned military site and then a trail
traveltime: From Gorno-Altaysk ≈3 h; from Ongudai ≈50 min
stay: Dinamo tourist base (km 582, bldg 12; 2026: 2,300 ₽/day for 1 adult, 3,700 ₽ for two with 3 meals a day, season 01.05–31.08 per putevka.com); the training center base “Seminsky Pass”; guesthouses in Tuekta, Topuchaya, Ongudai; the training center “Seminsky Pass” (km 582, 6; 4.9 from 222 ratings on 2GIS, cross-country skiing, lit tracks)
net: According to travelto — stable signal from all operators at the pass (not confirmed by other sources)
entry: Free (2026). There is no resort fee in the Altai Republic.
bring: Warm clothes even in summer (+15…+18 °C in July, wind, snow possible), cash for the market, a thermos
warn: Snow and ice are possible from September to May; strong westerly wind, blizzards in winter, down to −20 °C and below. R256 repairs in 2026: in the Altai Republic km 439–444 (Maima) and 560–570 (exit from Shebalino) have been repaired; until the end of 2026 work continues at km 455–472 (Souzga–Manzherok) and 479–495 (Izvestkovy–Barangol) — lane narrowing and reversible traffic are possible (Tolk, 06.10.2026). In 2026–2029 an 18 km reconstruction near Souzga–Manzherok with detours (Tolk, 24.03.2026). On 01.10.2026 a rockfall onto the road with no casualties was reported (NGS22; location not specified). The trakt is periodically closed for military convoys. For the Sarlyk hike clear weather is a must; it is 10–15 °C colder at the top, with wind up to 35 m/s. There is no border zone. Ticks: according to Rospotrebnadzor for the Altai Republic, by 25.08.2026 there were 3,600 reports of tick bites and 22 cases of tick-borne encephalitis (Ongudai District is among the districts with bites).
food: Cafes at km 582 (2GIS, 2026): “Kedr Zolotoy” — home cooking, 4.8 (64), average bill ≈250 ₽; “Shugurat” — 4.9 (69), average bill ≈450 ₽; “Priroda” (km 582, 12, at Dinamo) — 4.8 (49), average bill ≈950 ₽; “Seminsky” — average bill ≈600 ₽; “U Mikhailovny” — fast food. At the market — Altai honey, pine nuts, herbal teas, fish
reviews: Yandex Maps (viewpoint “Seminsky Pass”): 5.0, 13,140 ratings, 3,138 reviews (2026); TripAdvisor: 4.3 (24 reviews, No. 2 of 6 in Ongudai; in 2025 road repairs were noted). Pluses: views, cedars, the obelisk, toilets and cafes. Minuses: “prices are not always reasonable”, crowded, trading at the summit.

p.sum: A must-stop on the trakt at km 583: a platform with an obelisk, a market, cafes and toilets right by the road; in summer you can set off from here on a hike to Sarlyk, and in winter go skiing.
